_source: mn/REPORT.md Response Schema + mn/scripts/extract_probe.py (reference extractor, selectors verified against captures) + mn/data/probe.sqlite (jobs 19 rows, detail_fields 1 row)

detail_page.differences: same card markup; div.job-description__summary -> div.job-description__full (complete HTML, 8219 chars sampled); header 'Showing 1 jobs'; no pager
detail_page.no_structured_extras: no salary/type/category elements; street address + pay appear inside description prose only

facets.company: select[name=company] > option[value] — 500 companies + placeholder, true counts in labels (e.g. 'Walmart (1000)'); truncated at top 500
facets.loc: select[name=loc] > option[value] — 500 cities + placeholder, true counts in labels (e.g. 'Minneapolis, MN (7113)'); truncated at top 500; copy value byte-for-byte (~D~ escapes)
facets.sort: select[name=sort] values: best-match | date-posted-desc | job-title-asc | company-asc

job_id_dedupe_key: div.job-search-result @data-jvid e.g. '8eb1059c476c4ed5b62d5dd0dfd5198c8003' — 36 chars = 32 hex + literal suffix '8003' (170 distinct ids, one suffix)
location: same div > span[1] text e.g. 'Woodbury, MN' (map-pin pseudo-element); always 'City, MN' in samples; nullability UNKNOWN — tolerate None
posted_relative_only: first span in card starting with 'Posted' (class 'tw-text-gray-600 tw-text-[1.4rem]') e.g. 'Posted 1 day ago' — no absolute date on list OR detail
salary_is_prose_mining: regex on description text found 'wage range for this position is $23.00 to $31.00' (mn/data/probe.sqlite:detail_fields.salary_snippet); not a field
summary: div.job-description__summary text (~300 chars, truncated with '..'); detail page uses div.job-description__full
title: h3[id$="-title"] (h3[id=<jvid>-title]) text e.g. '(USA) Member Team Lead' — never null in 20 sampled rows
total_count_cosmetic: h2.view-header__result-summary-header 'Showing N jobs' = min(true_count, 500) — NOT a total; true counts live in facet option labels
